records.author: Edith Vale
records.title: Notebook of River Marks
records.summary: A slim survey notebook listing flood markers and route annotations.
extract: Vale records a chain of river marks beside the old cave road and suggests that several were reused as emergency trail signs decades later.
One entry cross-references a sketched lantern symbol that matches the modern investigation notes.

images.alt: A weathered cover image used to represent the notebook scan.
images.caption: Cover scan attached to the archive entry.

references: Acquired from the Vale estate donation ledger

records.author: M. A. Morton
records.title: Field Guide to Lanterns
records.summary: A practical maintenance guide for expedition lanterns.
extract: Morton describes wick trimming, lens storage, and the safest way to shield lanterns during narrow-corridor travel.
A short appendix recommends tagging lantern crates by route and weather risk.
references: Reference copy held in Equipment Annex / Shelf 7

records.author: R. Haskins
records.title: Catalogue of Northern Rooms
records.summary: An inventory of isolated rooms and storage buildings across the district.
extract: The catalogue organizes buildings by access route, supply risk, and seasonal occupancy.
A marginal note mentions a temporary records room being moved after repeated cave moisture damage.

images.alt: Illustration page showing a dark interior corridor.
images.caption: Illustration plate included with the catalogue entry.

references: Annotated by archivist N. Shepherd in 1947
